recap.headline: KINGS LAND THE COMBO
recap.subhead: Corner Three Kings won last week, won last night, and now sit No. 1 in the power rankings.
body: Corner Three Kings would have beaten 10 of 11 teams last week, then went out and took the night too. Even with Rookie McBucket's 29 points stuck on the bench. That's a flex.
Triple Double Trouble sits fourth in the standings and the sims still give them only a one-in-three shot at the playoffs. The record is writing checks the categories can't cash.
Punt Intended beat zero teams in all-play last week. Zero. The punt is now the whole strategy.

zingers.line: Benched Rookie McBucket for 29 points and lost the rebounds by four. The name was a warning, not a brand.
Beat eight teams on paper and lost anyway. Unlucky is the polite word. Soft is the accurate one.
Fourth in the standings with a one-in-three playoff shot. The record is lying to you and the sims know it.
Won the night with a 29-point scorer glued to the bench. Imagine if you tried.
Zero all-play wins last week. You punted eleven categories and the matchup.
Lost the threes lead by one make. One. Your shooter sat Saturday and you never noticed.
A free-agent center is carrying your boards. Your first-round pick is a decoration.
